nom: SUNDAY RILEY C.E.O. Afterglow Brightening Vitamin C Cream

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report the cream relieves flakiness and leaves skin smooth, supple, and well hydrated.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report it balances dry and oily areas without adding extra oiliness or causing breakouts, though one finds the citrus-floral scent too strong.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin overwhelmingly report no irritation, breakouts, or reactions, including several who say they are usually cautious with vitamin C products; one exception says she is still too reactive to this cream for it to help her existing breakouts.
segments.mature: Reviewers who describe their skin as mature or aging mostly report a smoother, brighter, more lifted look with continued use, though one reviewer in her mid-40s says she saw no significant change.

concerns.aging: Several reviewers, including those describing mature or aging skin, report improved firmness, elasticity, and fewer visible fine lines with continued use; one reviewer in her mid-40s, however, saw no significant change.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the cream as strongly hydrating, resolving dryness and flakiness on application; dissent includes one reviewer who found it not moisturizing enough on its own and another whose skin became dry and started peeling after several uses.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers, including one with rosacea, report visibly reduced redness with continued use, though one says her redness improved only partially rather than fully clearing.
concerns.spots: Most reviewers report visible fading of dark spots, sun spots, or hyperpigmentation with continued use, though one reviewer with hyperpigmentation says it made little difference to her brightness.
concerns.blemishes: Overwhelmingly, reviewers, including several who identify as acne-prone, report no new breakouts and sometimes fewer breakouts than usual; one exception says it neither improved nor prevented her existing breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with combination or oil-prone areas say the cream does not add shine or greasiness, though one reviewer notes it felt slightly greasy about an hour after application despite not looking oily.

aspects.libelle: Comes with a hygienic spatula applicator
Vivid yellow-orange tint can show on skin
Can pill under makeup or other products

extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really wanted to love this but unfortunately had a bad reaction to it. The yellow color was a bit off-putting and the scent was pretty strong but I could get past both those things. However when I used this I felt a stinging sensation, which I thought maybe was normal? (Not sure if it is or isn't). But after a few uses I found that my skin which is usually really nice was dry and peeling in certain areas and I had to stop using. I do really like the packaging and that it comes with a special spatula to scoop the product out so you don't have to stick your hands in it. Sadly my skin did not agree with this.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have sensitive/acne prone skin and this did not help any current breakouts or prevent any, I would say I'm too sensitive to this. It applies nicely and absorbs well. I feel the yellow tint does give a type of subtle glow to your skin. It smells like crushed up dandelions, which doesn't smell great. The container is pretty however I feel like the applicator is just something extra taking up space. I would prefer if it could fit into the container somehow.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It feels great, super moisturizing, doesn't feel tacky or sticky on the face, it smells very citrusy and lightweight. I didn't really see a difference as far as brightness. I suffer feom hyperpigmentation so it didnt really do alot for my skin as far as brightness.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I want to give this product 5 stars but I'm giving it 4 due to the fragrance. I got used to it the more I used it but it is very strong and when you are putting it on your face, if you are sensitive to strong scents, this might not be for you. But I loved the cream itself. It is bright yellow but once rubbed into your skin does not leave any yellow color or residue. This makes my skin feel so soft. It also allows me to apply my makeup evenly overtop of it. A little goes a long way so I anticipate this container lasting a while. I've been using it for a month now. I have combination dry/oily skin and it has helped with the dry areas without making my face oily. 5 stars for the product itself but the scent is just too overpowering!

extraits.titre: Luxurious skincare with visible skin improvement
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] As a 45 year-old woman, I've come to expect excellence from Sunday, Riley, and their C. E. O. Afterglow moisturizer does not disappoint. It's a high-quality formula that fits perfectly into a mature skin care routine. Thoughtful Design The packaging is beautiful, but I especially love the inclusion of the small spatula. The spatula is a game changer for two reasons: 1. Hygiene: it keeps bacteria from your hands out of the jar. 2. Product Integrity: it prevents the Vitamin C from degrading due to repeat finger contact, ensuring the formula stays potent. Texture and Wear The brands claim of a non-greasy, satin skin finish is 100% accurate. The gel cream texture is incredibly lightweight and absorbs almost instantly. Because it sinks in so quickly without leaving a taxi residue, it provides long lasting moisture that sits beautifully under makeup my foundation looks fresh all day without pilling or sliding. I have very textured skin and while this didn't physically smooth out my skin surface, it worked wonders on my complexion. I noticed significant Aunt brightening and more even skin tone. It has been particularly effective at fading the appearance of my age. Giving me vibrant, healthy skin. If you're looking for a quick absorbing luxurious moisturizer that tackles, hyper pigmentation and provides a perfect canvas for foundation, this is it.
